annotation.evidence_span: Implementations MUST support buffering at least 4096 bytes of data received in out of order CRYPTO frames.
annotation.interpretation_a: The implementation must support buffering at least 4096 bytes of data in total across all out‑of‑order CRYPTO frames.
annotation.interpretation_b: The implementation must support buffering at least 4096 bytes of data per out‑of‑order CRYPTO frame.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether the 4096‑byte minimum applies to the total amount of out‑of‑order data buffered or to each individual out‑of‑order frame, allowing two materially different implementation behaviours.
